اعترضتا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَرَضَتَا (iʕtaraḍatā) /iʕ.ta.ra.dˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
# اُعْتُرِضَتَا (uʕturiḍatā) /uʕ.tu.ri.dˤa.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْتَرَضَ (iʕtaraḍa)
